facts.fact: RURA's annual report 2020-2021 shows Rwanda's Universal Access and Service Fund, set up by Presidential Order n. 05/01 of 15/03/2004 and paid for by public operators' contributions, collected Frw 5,301,355,698 and spent Frw 3,828,837,334 in FY2020/21, 91% of it on telecommunications towers in underserved areas.

note: Budget (Frw 6,372,536,516) and spent figures are for FY2020/21, before 2024, so no allocated or spent fact; the fund's own account gives both collections and spending.
About Nigeria and Starlink; Rwanda is named only for Starlink approvals tied to rural connectivity commitments, no financing fact.

facts.fact: Budget tables: the budget for 2026/27 gives 92,074,979,130 RWF to 38 digital line(s). Dated by the budget document.

facts.fact: RURA Board Decision N 03/BD/ICT/RURA/2024 sets Universal Access Fund contributions on annual turnover, at 2% for network infrastructure and network services licensees and 0.5% for ISP retailers and postal licensees, under Presidential Order 025/01 of 2023.
ACET states that Rwanda allocated RWF 80.9 billion (about $58.5 million) to the ICT sector in its FY2024/25 budget.
